macros.token:
#set $sep = ' '
denoising.py 454 @CPUS@
## INPUTS #if $input_files.file_type == "archive" --input-archive '${input_files.input_archive}' #else --samples-names #for $current in $input_files.samples $sep'${current.samples_names.strip()}' #end for --input-R1 #for $current in $input_files.samples $sep'${current.input_R1}' #end for #end if
## AMPLICON PARAMETERS --min-amplicon-size $min_amplicon_size --max-amplicon-size $max_amplicon_size
## PRIMERS --five-prim-primer '$five_prim_primer' --three-prim-primer '$three_prim_primer'
## PROCESS TYPE #if $process_type.process == "preprocess-only" --process preprocess-only #elif $process_type.process == "clustering" --process swarm --distance $process_type.distance $process_type.cluster_improvements.clustering_options #end if
## OUTPUTS --output-biom $output_biom --output-fasta $output_fasta --html $html #if $process_type.process == "clustering" --output-compo $output_cluster_compo #end if

param.name: file_type
param.label: Input type
param.help: Samples files can be provided in a single TAR archive or sample by sample (with one or two files each).

param.label: TAR archive file
param.help: The TAR file containing the 454 single end reads fastq file for each sample.

param.label: Minimum amplicon size
param.help: The minimum size of the amplicons (with primers)

param.label: Maximum amplicon size
param.help: The maximum size of the amplicons (with primers). For paired-end reads substract 10 bases corresponding to the minimum overlap between reads.

param.label: 5' primer
param.help: The 5' primer sequence (wildcards are accepted). This primer must be written in 5' to 3' orientation.

param.label: 3' primer
param.help: The 3' primer sequence (wildcards are accepted). This primer must be written in 5' to 3' orientation (see details in 'Primers parameters' help section)

param.label: Process type
param.help: Select the type of process to perform

param.label: Distance threshold
param.help: The distance threshold for clustering with Swarm

param.name: clustering_options
param.label: Additionnally refine or denoise clustering
param.help: In association with --distance 1, use the Swarm --fastidious option to refine clustering (recommended since FROGS 3.2). Or use the --denoising FROGS option to perform pre-clustering with --distance = 1 before clustering with user defined distance.
param.option: Refine clusters with --fastidiouis option (recommended since FROGS 3.2)
Do not refine or denoise clustering
